title: fix(objectql): don't stamp runtime-authored metadata into a loaded code package
body:
## Problem (found by dogfooding Studio as a business user)

Designed a custom object (`maint_asset`) from scratch in Studio, **published it, and it immediately became read-only** with the banner *"此条目由代码包提供，无法在运行时修改"* (provided by a code package — cannot be modified at runtime). I had just created it, yet I could no longer edit it.

Root cause confirmed at the data layer — the `sys_metadata` row was stamped with a **code package's** id:

```
name = maint_asset
type = object
package_id = app.objectstack.hotcrm   ← a code package
scope = platform
```

Studio sends the currently-selected package dropdown value via `?package=` as a *viewing* context. `saveMetaItem` persisted that id verbatim as the brand-new row's `package_id`, so the org object read back as code-provided and locked itself.

## Fix

`saveMetaItem` now drops the package binding for a **runtime-only** (DB-only, non-artifact-backed) write whose target is a **loaded code package**, persisting it as a plain org overlay (`package_id = null`, editable).

Two scopes are deliberately **left bound**:
- **`override-artifact`** writes — an org overlay *of* a packaged item must keep pointing at that package.
- writes into a **non-loaded "authoring workspace"** package id (a bare id with no booted manifest) — ADR-0048 #1824 per-package scoping must survive.

`isLoadedPackage` distinguishes them via the engine manifest map (every `registerApp` records it) + a registered-objects/apps fallback. The coercion mutates `request.packageId` so **every** downstream consumer (repo write, parent-version lookup, the live registry mutation on publish, audit) sees the same value — coercing only the repo write left the in-memory object stamped and still read-only (caught in E2E).

## Verification

- **3 new unit tests** (`protocol-save-meta-repo-path.test.ts`): runtime-only + loaded package → dropped; runtime-only + non-loaded package → kept (#1824); override-artifact → kept.
- **Full `@objectstack/objectql` suite green: 695 tests**; typecheck + eslint clean.
- **End-to-end against a live showcase server**: creating an object under the loaded `com.example.showcase` package now stores `package_id = null` and reads back org-owned/editable; the guard logs the coercion.

## Notes

This surfaced during a broader Studio dogfooding pass. Other findings (objectui-side: a freshly-added select field seeds an empty-value option that fails spec validation; untranslated English strings + free-text target-object input in the lookup config) are UI-repo issues to be filed separately.
